v1.target: -RA9 in year Y+1 (raw, pooled across seasons)
v1.note: legacy convention; the shipped gate verdicts were established here

v2.target: -RA9 in year Y+1 (within-OUTCOME-season z-score removes the era term)
v2.bootstrap: player-clustered (all of a player's pairs move together), season-stratified (players stratified by first predictor season); 2000 reps, seeded; CIs are wider by design
v2.note: transition-cycle companion; future gates must pre-declare v1 or v2

harness.pair_rule: Y->Y+1 pairs kept only when the OUTCOME season is complete (past Nov 15). Partial-year targets (e.g. mid-2026) are a defect, dropped under BOTH conventions.
harness.predictors: unrounded *_raw model scores (display rounding never enters evals)
interpretation_rules: existing VALIDATED ships STAND even if v2 weakens them; a reversal is flagged to the owner, not auto-reverted
ledgered NO-SHIPs are re-baselined under v2 but never revived by v2 alone
X-R2 / X-S2 flips are not promised

gate.bar: beats ERA (gap lo95 > 0) AND not worse than raw FIP (lo95 >= -0.01)

prior_artifact_defect: the 2026-07-07 shipped artifact's n=702 included 2025->2026 pairs whose target was a mid-2026 partial season; harness v2 drops partial-outcome pairs

gb_adjusted_candidate.verdict: NO SHIP: the GB-adjusted core does not beat plain FIP forward out of sample; plain FIP stays. Starter samples are large enough that the observed HR rate is already a strong estimate.

verdict.summary: Forward-chained OOS over 7 seasons (592 Y->Y+1 pairs, complete outcome seasons only): SEM+ predicts next-year RA9 at rho 0.4167 vs raw FIP 0.3821, ERA 0.2843. CI on the rho gap vs ERA {'mean': 0.1326, 'lo95': 0.0797, 'hi95': 0.1844}, vs raw FIP {'mean': 0.0342, 'lo95': 0.0177, 'hi95': 0.0508}. Shipped VALIDATED: SEM+ beats the ERA baseline and is not worse than its raw-FIP parent, so the empirical-Bayes shrinkage + starter-pool anchoring earn their place. Durability rides separate context columns.
